title: Voyager site adapter: folder appearance
description: Design tokens for the sidebar folder section and its shadow popover. Kept outside folders for older clients. Unknown or invalid tokens drop the skin; online readers retain the bundled skin. No selectors, CSS property names, storage or account policy are accepted. The runtime reader additionally checks colour function arguments, nesting and metric bounds.

rowHeight.description: Row height, 16-64px, optionally following a host CSS variable with a bounded fallback.

rowRadius.description: Row radius, 0-32px, optionally following a host CSS variable with a bounded fallback.

dark.description: Overrides for dark mode. Omitted colours inherit from the light palette.

header.description: An opaque sticky header that reserves the corner occupied by a host history control. Requires light.sidebar.

color.description: Hex, transparent, rgb/rgba, var(--name, fallback), or color-mix(in oklab|srgb, color percentage%, transparent). Variables require a valid fallback. RGB channels, alpha and mix percentages are bounded; nesting is limited. No resources, declaration escapes or arbitrary CSS are allowed.
